procedural_audit.sequence: Recorded before independent code/Rust review and separate security review.
resolved_items: Receipt-directory correction preserved RED/GREEN bytes and failure status.
Mixed old/current coverage object maps corrected using unchanged profdata and exactly five tested executable objects, no exclusion or rerun; initial report retained.
limits: No paired campaign or performance conclusion yet.
No extra reviewer tests, builds, experiments, analyzer or archive.

reviewed: Validated first-template literal fragments and unchanged primitive parser preserve token/layout boundaries, lexical bytes and complete record coverage; fixed 32-slot storage is bounded by artifact admission.

UTF-8, record/target/count limits and strict encoded-size fallback remain intact. Successful speculation reproduces first-candidate work charge, exact-budget success and terminal overflow; failed speculation emits and charges nothing before generic fallback.

Frozen oracle is byte-identical to baseline schema.rs. Existing observed tests cover SCVAL and complete zstd frame equality, both decoders, malformed/lexical/size/slot/count boundaries, mixed fallback and one output allocation for 1/128/4096 prepared matching records.
No receiver, authentication, public API, wire format or zstd profile production change. Candidate crate tree matches the frozen source.

Same harness in baseline/candidate with balanced source order, exact immediate/reopen checks, bounded fresh owned stores and retained failures. Captured body buffers move without cloning; transcript hashing follows timers. Matched capture changes buffer lifetime versus prior campaigns, so only this paired comparison supports the optimization claim.

Sender CPU excludes nested exchange; receiver CPU is nested in exchange. Profile calls are independent and not additive stages. Actual seed/preparation totals remain separate from target-only figures. Baseline/candidate plans match after removing only the schema source hash.
limits: Performance gate remains unmeasured; this is local synthetic qualification, not WAN speed evidence.
Failed first-template speculation adds a bounded scan; variant/drift/unrelated and ordinary-zstd controls must remain visible.
Allocation count concerns test-thread Rust System requests only, not RSS, zstd internal allocation or energy.
One read-only jq comparison initially failed due expression grouping (exit 5); corrected grouping returned true without modifying data.

security_review.independent_reviewer: selector_measurement; production-only scope excludes its authored harness

results_review.method: Read existing raw rows, summary, run/pin receipts and report; bounded read-only jq recomputation, no test/build/benchmark rerun or new analyzer project.
results_review.conclusion: All source/executable and planned fixture identities, exactness, paired frame costs, timer nesting, primary ratios, report values, seed/preparation totals and cache/retention claims agree. Delivery, optimization ledger and crate README are consistent with the measured result.
limits_preserved: Unchanged body bytes; improvement is matching-layout sender CPU.
Ordinary zstd still uses less CPU and local elapsed time; its own wall-time variation prevents attributing the whole elapsed shift solely to code.
Drift and small unrelated regressions remain visible; setup is charged for actual sessions and no refit cost is invented.
Local serialized durable transfers only; no new WAN, energy, RSS, larger-object or MVM claim.
